title: Demo: Review a fictional bank payment-reconciliation issue through TrustGraph
body:
## Task
Demonstrate TrustGraph's exact-action approval workflow using a fictional bank payment-reconciliation GitHub issue proposal for TrustGraph Demo, WO-2.

Project: 6b23e5ca-1d03-46a7-93dd-6a3608432db7
Work order: WO-2

## Acceptance criteria
- The human operator manually submits this proposal to TrustGraph for permission checks and review.
- Before execution, the human approves the exact title, body, repository, connected account and configured tool binding.
- Any content change requires fresh approval.
- Preview receipts are identified as simulated; only a live provider receipt confirms issue creation.
- No code changes, patch generation, pull requests, merges or direct agent GitHub writes are performed.

This draft is not approval or permission to publish and has not been submitted or published.
